title.value: NL-PS-L3-A - Level 3a: One minimal GBB per section - Patient id

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 3a test patient, in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least one entry that refers to a generic building block (GBB) in the document, and has a narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab searches the Patient Summary of the Patient id you enter at test setup. Enter the id of your level 3a test patient, without 'Patient/'. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
Patient.id of your level 3a test patient, without 'Patient/'.
Search the NL-PS Composition of the test patient with the Patient id entered at test setup.
